answer_1.quote: ...We primarily evaluate loss truncation on abstractive summarization ... We also performed a preliminary evaluation of our approach on the E2E NLG task...
answer_1.outputs: generated news headlines/summaries and restaurant review texts

answer_2.quote: ...We used ROUGE-L for summarization and BLEU score for E2E. ...

answer_4.quote: ...We used Amazon Mechanical Turk ... For each generated title, we asked 9 crowd workers to measure the typicality ... For measuring factuality, we asked two crowd workers how much information in the generated title was present in the article...
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to rate typicality of the generated title and to judge how much of the information in the title was contained in the article.
